{{Quote|Time is likely critical for your people. Will you turn your back on the Emperor and take the ''Chimaera'' to your worlds to assist in their survival?|Darth Vader, to Thrawn|<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" />}}
The '''''Chimaera''''' {{Pronounced|kaɪˈmɪərə}} was a modified [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[captain]]ed by [[Imperial officer]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. It served as his [[flagship]] following his promotions to [[commodore]] and later [[admiral]] of the [[96th Task Force]], and transferred commands with him from the task force to flagship of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] upon his promotion to [[Grand Admiral]]. During the [[Liberation of Lothal]], the ''Chimaera'' was pulled into [[hyperspace]] by [[purrgil]] summoned by the young [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] with Thrawn, Bridger, and most of its crew aboard.

The ''Chimaera'' travelled to a [[far galaxy]] and settled on [[Peridea]] where it waited for [[Standard year|years]]. Upon the arrival of [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial Remnant]] [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]] under the [[witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]], the ''Chimaera'' returned to [[the galaxy]] docked to the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', a massive extragalactic [[hyperspace transport ring]] above [[Dathomir]]. The ''Chimaera'' was unique in that it had a stylized depiction of a [[Chimaera (symbol)|chimaera]] engraved on the ventral side of its [[hull]].

==Description==
The ''Chimaera'' was a modified [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> that had many design differences from standard ''Imperial I''s. On the underside of its hull, the ''Chimaera'' had a large engraving representing a [[Chimaera (symbol)|chimaera]].<ref name="Rebel Recon">{{RebelsRecon|netG0u3D2F0|#3.15: Inside "Trials of the Darksaber" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-trials-of-the-darksaber}}</ref> Thrawn had first been exposed to the artistic depiction of chimaeras as a [[Senior Captain]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]] when he met a [[Paccosh]] official named [[Uingali foar Marocsaa]]. Uingali, fearing his [[species]]' extinction at the hands of the [[Nikardun]], entrusted Thrawn with a [[Marocsaa subclan ring|double-ring of a chimaera]], a prized heirloom of the [[Marocsaa subclan]].<ref name="Chaos Rising">''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising]]''</ref>

[[File:Octupple_Barbette_Turbolaser_Turrets.png|thumb|left|150px|The ''Chimaera'' was equipped with eight-barreled turrets]]
Another difference was the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} eight turbolasers surrounding its [[conning tower]]. Unlike some other ''Imperial I''s that had large double-barreled turrets,<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> the Star Destroyers of the Seventh Fleet featured eight-barreled turrets.<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> Additionally, the ''Chimaera'' had two opposite [[hangar]] bays, one located at either end of its ventral docking bay,<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> unlike some other ''Imperial I''-classes.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> A large door could cover the aft bay when it was not in use.<ref name="Armada">{{Armada|set=Chimaera Expansion Pack}}</ref>

==History==
===Early service under Thrawn===
====Defending an Imperial space station====
[[File:Chimaera-Thrawn4.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Thrawn receives the ''Chimaera''.]]
The ''Chimaera'' was an ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer that saw service during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Just as the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|seeds of rebellion]] began to spread across [[the galaxy]], the vessel was placed under the command of the [[Chiss]] [[officer]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] during his promotion to [[commodore]] by [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[governor]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Starship|ship]], with Thrawn as its skipper, was dispatched to quell early rebel uprisings, with his protege [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Karyn Faro]] serving as the Chiss' [[Executive officer|first officer]].<ref name="Thrawn" />

Thrawn captained the vessel for some [[time]], using his effective tactics to deal with the Empire's enemies. One of the rebel groups gaining influence at the time was under the command of a mastermind who went by "[[Nevil Cygni|Nightswan]]." Nightswan had been Thrawn's personal nemesis for [[Standard year|years]], although the two had never truly been formally acquainted. The ''Chimaera'' received orders to aid the [[Attack on the Sempre|recently attacked]] [[transport]] vessel ''[[Sempre]]'', which Thrawn believed was attacked by Nightswan's forces. He theorized the attack was led by the recently stolen [[frigate]] ''[[Castilus]]''. In an effort to arrive at the scene as soon as possible and ensure that they were prepared to face whatever awaited them, Thrawn ordered Faro to inspect the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} weaponry and [[engine]]s.<ref name="Thrawn" />

The ''Chimaera'' was unable to reach the ''Sempre'' in time, finding it adrift and the crew [[Death|killed]]. Thrawn ultimately determined that the ''Sempre'' was actually carrying [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slaves]], and that they had been rescued by rebels. In an attempt to neutralize the [[terrorist]]s deemed to be behind the attack, the ''Chimaera'' headed to the space station [[Lansend Twenty-Six]], an Imperial slave processing center and former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[fortress]]. The station had fallen under attack by the time the ''Chimaera'' arrived, under an assault spearheaded by the ''Castilus''. [[Colonel]] [[Zenoc]], the station's [[commander]], did not have sufficient [[Imperial Military|forces]] to defend it from the insurgents. The presence of the ''Chimaera'' turned the tide of the battle. The ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] escort kept the frigate ''Castilus'' and its detachment of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]]s occupied while the [[Star Destroyer]] itself fired upon the Imperial space station, concentrating all batteries on the areas where the attackers and escaped slaves were located. Once it had eliminated the threats within the fortress, the ''Chimaera'' turned its fire on the ''Castilus'', neutralizing the frigate's threat and emerging victorious from the battle.<ref name="Thrawn" />

====Pacifying a rogue governor====
The ''Chimaera'' continued to deal with insurgent threats under Thrawn's command. A few years before the [[Galactic Civil War]], it was dispatched to the [[Belsmuth sector]], where [[Governor]] [[Quesl]] of [[Botajef]] declared his planet independent from the Empire's rule. Quesl declared the Galactic Empire to be tyrannical, oppressive, and illegitimate;<ref name="Thrawn" /> wording that would later be echoed by the [[Declaration of Rebellion]].<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref>

The ''Chimaera'' rendezvoused with [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Jok Donassius]], who needed assistance [[Battle for Botajef|reclaiming]] Botajef for the Empire. Arriving in the Belsmuth [[sector]], the ''Chimaera'' began to carry out initial strikes against the Botajef revolutionaries. The planetary defenses were very strong, and one Star Destroyer would not be enough to subdue the world. Fighter wings under the command of the [[Starfighter Commander]] [[Senior Lieutenant]] [[Yve]] were dispatched to perform fly-by's past the two [[Botajef Defense Force]] [[CR90 corvette|CR90]] [[corvette]]s that [[orbit]]ed the planet. The Imperials were informed that they were invading the sovereign territory of the [[Jefi]], a species indigenous to Botajef.<ref name="Thrawn" />

Soon thereafter, the ''Chimaera'' began its attack. Using its [[tractor beam]]s, the ''Chimaera'' subdued one of the corvettes, which was manned entirely by Jefi. In the meantime, the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} TIEs made short work of the planetary [[turbolaser]]s. After focusing firepower on various planetary bombardments, the defense emplacements were effectively neutralized. With the planetary forces in disarray, the ''Chimaera'' could focus on capturing the second corvette, which was manned by [[human]]s. Thrawn had pieced together that Governor Quesl's supposedly righteous and revolutionary rhetoric about justice and self-determinate was a ruse for Quesl to [[Thief|steal]] Botajef's valuable artwork, and that the Governor would not trust his life to the Jefi. After his CR90 corvette was captured, Quesl surrendered and agreed to return to Coruscant and face trial for [[treason]].<ref name="Thrawn" />

===Serving the 96th Task Force===
{{Quote|I am content with the Ninety-Sixth Task Force.|Thrawn|<ref name="Thrawn" />}}
Due to his success, Thrawn was promoted to the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[admiral]] and assigned command of the [[96th Task Force]]. Even as he assumed control of the task force, the ''Chimaera'' remained under his command, serving as his [[command ship]]. The captaincy of the vessel was granted to a newly promoted Commander Faro, with his other protege Commander [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]] as another of the ship's [[commanding officer]]s. The ''Chimaera'' and the Ninety-Sixth were dispatched to the planet [[Batonn]] to deal with a [[Batonn insurgents|faction of insurgents]] in the midst of a mounting [[Batonn sector insurgency|uprising in the sector]]. At the last [[Standard minute|minute]], however, the ''Chimaera'' and the Ninety-Sixth were recalled after Thrawn refused to initiate an immediate attack against the rebels on [[Scrim Island]].<ref name="Thrawn" />

The ''Chimaera'' and the other vessels of the Ninety-Sixth were diverted to [[Sammun]] to quell the [[Sammun insurgents|rebellion]] on that planet. On Sammun, the Empire secured a victory, with the rebels surrendering after two of their ships were destroyed and another four were captured. With the [[Battle of Sammun|battle]] over, the ''Chimaera'' returned to Batonn to reinforce Admiral [[Durril]] and the [[One Oh Third Task Force]], which was in complete disarray. However, instead of assisting the broken [[Imperial Navy|Imperial fleet]], which was being battered by the planetary defenses, the ''Chimaera'' remained a safe distance from the fray. Upon returning to Batonn, Thrawn sent Vanto to confront Nightswan, who turned out to be Nevil Cygni, a former military contracting consultant who used his resources to fund a growing rebellion.<ref name="Thrawn" />

[[File:96thTaskForce-Thrawn5.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Chimaera'' during the battle for Scrim Island]]
Thrawn and Vanto eventually returned to the ''Chimaera'', which was then tasked with destroying the rebel base on Scrim Island. Instead of firing directly upon the [[Scrim Island Imperial garrison|fortress]], the ''Chimaera'' fired its [[ion cannon]]s in the oceans surrounding the island, triggering a [[tsunami]]. Thrawn and Vanto once again headed down to the surface to meet with high command. In the meantime, full control of the ''Chimaera'' and the Ninety-Sixth Task Force was handed over to Commander Faro, who remained in command over both the vessel and the [[fleet]] during the [[Batonn insurgency|Battle of Batonn]]. Not long after, most planetary forces and rebel ships in orbit were destroyed. What was left of Nightswan's force then retreated to [[Paeragosto City]], holing up in the [[Creekpath Mining and Refining complex]]. The ''Chimaera'' could not bombard the facility without destroying the entire [[city]], so the [[capital ship]] remained in high orbit, awaiting further orders.<ref name="Thrawn" />

[[File:BatonnSpaceBattle-Thrawn6.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Chimaera'' attacks rebel ships over Batonn.]]
Thrawn, who respected his nemesis Cygni greatly, met the insurgent leader covertly to learn his reasons for opposing the Empire. Thrawn offered Nightswan a position within his native [[Chiss Ascendancy]], believing his adversary could be of great service to his people. Nightswan refused the offer, stating that his people were here, and understanding that he would die on Batonn for his convictions.<ref name="Thrawn" />

After meeting Cygni face to face, Thrawn returned to the ''Chimaera'' and reassumed command of his ship. A fleet of thirty rebel starships emerged out of [[hyperspace]] not long after, engulfing the ''Chimaera'' in the fray. While commandeered [[light cruiser]]s managed to shield the Star Destroyer from the bulk of the fleet's fire, the ''Chimaera'' was still exposed. It positioned itself behind the [[cruiser]]s, which were, in fact, bait to attract most of the enemy's fire. Wings of TIE fighters were then sent to harass the fleet, while the ''Chimaera'' focused all fire on the ships. The insurgency on the surface was crushed after an [[Siege of the Creekpath Mining and Refining complex|explosion]] destroyed all remaining rebel forces in the mines and many civilians and Imperial personnel. Unbeknownst to practically anyone else, the explosion was secretly caused by Thrawn's friend [[Arihnda Pryce]] the acting ruler and governor of her homeworld [[Lothal]]. Continuously weakened by the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} fire and disheartened by news of the death of Nightswan and the planetary insurgents, the remnants of the insurgent fleet retreated, granting the Ninety-Sixth Task Force a strategic victory.<ref name="Thrawn" />

After the victory at Batonn, Thrawn was commended for what were believed to be his actions. In fact, Thrawn sharply disapproved of the unnecessary loss of so many civilian lives, but his career was advanced anyway for the eradication of the rebels and the pacification of the sector. In exchange for his many years of service, Thrawn was promoted to the prestigious rank of [[Grand Admiral]] by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and placed in command of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|7th Fleet]] at the recommendation of Governor Pryce since [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Sartan]] was getting replaced. The ''Chimaera'' transferred with Thrawn, going on to serve as the [[flagship]] of the 7th Fleet.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

===Flagship of the 7th Fleet===
====Hunting the Phoenix Cell====
{{Quote|Shuttle TYA77, transmit clearance codes.''"<br />"''Copy, ''Chimaera'', transmitting codes now.|An Imperial shuttle prepares to land aboard the ''Chimaera''|<ref name="Through Imperial Eyes" />}}
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Steps Into Shadow date">{{RebelsDate|301}}</ref> Governor Pryce lacked the forces to deal with a growing [[Spectres|rebel threat]] in her [[Lothal sector|sector]] and correctly suspected they were affiliated with a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|galaxy-wide rebel movement]]. Pryce believed the current chief Imperial military officer stationed in Lothal, Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]], was grossly incompetent and more of a politician than a soldier, so she petitioned Grand Moff Tarkin to provide professional assistance to eliminate the rebels from her friend and the 7th Fleet and to strengthen the Empire's hold over her sector and Tarkin agreed.<ref name="Steps Into Shadow">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref>

[[File:Imperial_fleet_above_Lothal-Sw_Rebels_S3-Iron_Squadron.png|thumb|right|250px|The 7th Fleet over Lothal]]
After learning the Lothal insurgents were en-route to [[Mykapo]] to [[Skirmish over Mykapo|extract]] [[Iron Squadron|rebel sympathizers]], Thrawn dispatched Konstantine to put a stop to the operation with a single [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]]. The ''Chimaera'' traveled to the system in order to reinforce the defeated officer, although the rebels were able to escape the battle.<ref name="Iron Squadron" />

Thrawn continued the hunt for the Lothal rebels, sending out Imperial [[E-XD-series infiltrator droid]]s to secretly land on worlds in search of their hidden base. [[EXD-9]], one of the droids, landed on [[Chopper Base]] and began its [[EXD-9's infiltration of Chopper Base|infiltration]] of the facility, but was compromised when [[Fulcrum]] informed the rebels of the infiltration. The droid was ultimately powered off after a skirmish against Captain [[Garazeb Orrelios]]; however, it was programmed to [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruct]] if it was powered off while in combat mode. Orrelios and the [[droid]]s [[C1-10P]] and [[AP-5]] managed to disrupt the program long enough to send the unit back to the Imperial fleet and detonate its [[proton warhead]]. After Imperial [[engineer]]s discovered it had returned and reactivated it, the droid self-destructed, destroying the ''Imperial'' Star Destroyer it docked with. The ''Chimaera'' was present for this, and as a result, [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] boarded the ship to inform the Grand Admiral. Thrawn was relatively unconcerned by this, as the sabotage helped narrow his search for the rebel base from a thousand systems to just ninety-four.<ref name="Warhead">{{Rebels|Warhead (episode)}}</ref>

As the 7th Fleet continued to [[blockade]] Lothal, Thrawn requested many officers who encountered the Spectres to visit the ''Chimaera''. These included [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]], Kallus, Konstantine, Pryce, sector command staff Captain [[Slavin]], Commander [[Brom Titus]], and Captain [[Brunson]]. Lyste had recently captured a disguised [[Ezra Bridger]], who wanted to [[Rescue of Alexsandr Kallus|rescue Kallus]], as he was secretly Fulcrum. Bridger was brought aboard the ''Chimaera''. While Bridger was locked away in [[Detention Block B7]], Thrawn, Konstantine, Kallus's mentor and Thrawn's old friend ISB [[Colonel]] [[Wullf Yularen]], Kallus and Lyste met in [[Thrawn's Office]]. There, the Grand Admiral informed them of a rebel [[spy]] threat, and that one of them was likely a traitor. Later, Kallus made his way to the Detention Block to release Bridger, using Lyste's [[code cylinder]]. They then made their way to Thrawn's office to erase information of the Rebels' base from his database, while also gaining clearance codes so the retrieval team could land and extract them.<ref name="Through Imperial Eyes" />

[[File:Through_Imperial_Eyes_thumb.png|thumb|left|250px|Thrawn and assembled Imperial personnel]]
Thrawn noticed the [[prisoner]]'s escape and returned to his office to investigate any tampering. Kallus, Chopper, and Ezra hid while he inspected his office, while Kallus reprogrammed Thrawn's [[sentry droid]]s in the adjacent [[Thrawn's sparring gym|gym]] to attack the Chiss. However, the Grand Admiral, a skilled martial artists, was ultimately able to disable them. Bridger's Master [[Jedi Knight]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] and Captain [[Rex]] landed on the ship with a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], and attempted to extract Bridger and Kallus using [[stormtrooper armor]] as cover. However, Pryce confronted the intruders and attempted to shoot them. Seeing Pryce shooting at who he thought to be actual [[stormtrooper]]s, Lyste [[stun]]ned her with his [[blaster]], erroneously believing her to be the traitor. This chaos both allowed the Rebels to escape and provided Kallus with an alibi as he had successfully framed Lyste as the traitor. Kallus thus chose to stay behind on the ''Chimaera'' to continue his role as Fulcrum. However, Yularen and Thrawn later discussed the outcome of the incident, not satisfied with the results. They both concluded that Lyste was far too loyal to the cause to be capable of treason, correctly deducing that the only possible traitor was Kallus.<ref name="Through Imperial Eyes" />

====Zero Hour====
{{Main|Battle of Atollon}}
[[File:Battle_of_Atollon.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Chimaera'' and the rest of the Seventh Fleet blockade Atollon.]]
After more investigation, Thrawn was able to discover the location of the rebel hideout, which was situated on the planet [[Atollon]]. Just as [[Phoenix Squadron|Phoenix Cell]] prepared to launch a surprise [[Attack on Lothal|Attack]] on Lothal with the intention to destroy the [[Imperial Armory Complex]], they received a transmission from Kallus that Thrawn knew, delaying the Attack. After realizing what Kallus did, Thrawn saw it as an opportune time to apprehend Kallus, subduing the double agent after a short fight. Thrawn mobilized a portion of the 7th Fleet from aboard the ''Chimaera'' and set course for Atollon.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

After little time to prepare, the rebels found themselves outgunned and outmatched by the 7th Fleet, which was commanded by Thrawn and Pryce on the ''Chimaera''. The rebels proved no match for the fleet, which managed to destroy the forces of [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] within the early stages of the [[Battle of Atollon]]. To make matters worse, the broken rebel fleet was unable to jump to [[lightspeed]] due to an active [[Interdictor]] vessel captained by Konstantine. Admiral Konstantine defied Thrawn's orders and broke formation to face the rebel flagship ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'' commanded by Commander [[Jun Sato]]. Sato evacuated his ship and crashed it into Konstantine's, killing both men and destroying both vessels. The destruction of the interdictor gave Lieutenant Commander Bridger the opening he needed to seek out reinforcements before Thrawn could order the activation of the second interdictor.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

[[File:Seventh_Fleet.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[orbital bombardment]] of Atollon]]
The ''Chimaera'' and the rest of the 7th Fleet decimated the entire rebel squadron, forcing what remained of their ships to the surface. Although the rebels managed to raise the base's [[Deflector shield|shields]] just in time, Thrawn ordered the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} turbolasers turned to the ground to intimidate the rebels. When he believed that the rebels had finally had enough, Thrawn mobilized a ground party consisting of Imperial [[walker]]s and a large detachment of [[infantry]], heading down to the surface with his new [[squad|guard squadron]] of [[death trooper]]s assigned by the Emperor. Thrawn temporarily relinquished control of the ''Chimaera'' to Pryce, who commanded the fleet in orbit.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

While Thrawn led the ground assault, the ''Chimaera'' and the rest of the fleet were faced with the unexpected arrival of Bridger leading a small [[Clan Wren|force]] of [[Mandalorian]]s. The third party managed to take down the second Interdictor ship, allowing the remnants of the rebel fleet to escape. Aboard the flagship, Pryce ordered Agent Kallus to be [[Death penalty|killed]] by shooting him out of the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[airlock]]. However, Kallus used his prowess to incapacitate two stormtroopers in an [[Turbolift|elevator]] and slipped away to the ship's [[escape pod]]s and was rescued by the rebels before they jumped into hyperspace.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

====Working with Darth Vader====
{{Quote|While Woldar and Tarkin find and deal with the rebels, you and Lord Vader will take your flagship to deal with this other matter.|Emperor Palpatine, to Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" />}}
[[File:Sector56-ThrawnAlliances1.png|left|thumb|249x249px|The ''Chimaera'' puts down a threat to shipping in Sector 56]]
Following Thrawn's incomplete victory at Atollon,<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances2">''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''</ref> the ''Chimaera'' was tasked with [[Engagement in Sector 56|putting down]] a threat to shipping in [[Sector 56]] as part of an effort to bring a star system under Imperial control. The resulting engagement ended with a truce which neutralized the shipping threat and the system being brought under Imperial control.<ref name="TA12">[[Thrawn: Alliances 1|''Thrawn: Alliances'' 1]]</ref>

Following the battle, the ''Chimaera'' returned to Coruscant with Thrawn. After receiving word of his unfinished victory, Emperor Palpatine did not take the 7th Fleet away from him, as he knew the reason for his failure was due to [[Bendu|factors]] not under the Grand Admiral's control. However, Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] and Thrawn's old friend [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] did not share his [[Sith Master|Master]]'s patience on the matter. Therefore, Emperor Palpatine tasked Thrawn and Vader to take the ''Chimaera'' to the planet [[Batuu]] to deal with a recent [[disturbance in the Force]] felt by Palpatine while Tarkin took the 7th Fleet to hunt down the Rebel Alliance. Thrawn and Vader also traveled to [[Mokivj]] to investigate another disturbance. Upon their visit, they realized the [[Grysk]]s, the archenemy of Thrawn and the Chiss Ascendancy, threatened the security of the Empire. Thrawn, who studied their tactics and who pledged to fully protect the Ascendancy, whom the Grysks also were at odds with, bought the Empire time to prepare for their upcoming skirmish after the ''Chimaera,'' along with Vader and Thrawn's team of TIE Defender starfighters, attacked the Grysks. The Grysk forces dispatched were destroyed entirely, with a [[Steadfast (Chiss heavy cruiser)|Chiss courier ship]] escaping the battle.<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" />

====The battle for Lothal====
{{Quote|Whatever happens next happens to both of us.''"<br />"''That's the idea.|Thrawn and Ezra Bridger|<ref name="Family&Farewell">{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}}</ref>}}
Some time later, the ''Chimaera'' and the 7th Fleet returned to orbit over Lothal. Soon after at the order of [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] herself, the Spectres returned to Lothal to help the [[Lothal resistance group]] and [[Theft of the TIE Defender Elite|learn about]] Thrawn's [[TIE/D Defender Elite]] program. Following a [[Flight data recorder|successful]] mission on the surface, Captain [[Hera Syndulla]] and her droid [[C1-10P]] attempted to get out of the system in a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]. Despite Thrawn trying to stop the [[starfighter]] from the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} bridge, the craft managed to escape by commencing a hyperspace jump through an [[ICM-092792|Imperial construction module]].<ref name="Kindred">{{Rebels|Kindred}}</ref>

[[File:SWR_Attack_on_Lothal.png|thumb|right|250px|Rebel X-wings engage the blockade.]]
Over a dozen Rebel [[X-wing starfighter]]s and a dozen [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing bomber]]s arrived soon after to tarf the long awaited [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] and destroy the Imperial Armory Complex. They fought the Imperial blockade and the newly promoted [[General]] Syndulla lured Commander [[Vult Skerris]] over the ''Chimaera''. Thrawn warned Skerris to steer clear as he prepared the ''Chimaera'' to fire on Syndulla, but Skerris refused, keen to kill his rival. Thrawn commenced the firing, and both fighters lost their shielding in the barrage. Syndulla then attacked Skerris's fighter, and he crashed into a cruiser, sending it hurling into a Star Destroyer. The remaining X-wings and all of the Y-wings then made for the surface. However, Thrawn prepared for such an event since he knew of Syndulla's skill and had a second swarm of TIE fighters in the atmosphere attack the X-wings and the Y-wings, all of which were destroyed. All of the pilots were captured or killed, excluding Captain [[Mart Mattin]], who escaped with the help of the Lothal resistance group.<ref name="Rebel Assault" />

Shortly thereafter, Thrawn took the ''Chimaera'' to [[Coruscant]] when he was summoned to attend an important meeting with Emperor Palpatine that Governor Tarkin already arranged over the funding for his TIE Defender program because thanks to General Syndulla's bootless attack on Lothal, his rival [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] of the [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research|Imperial Weapons Division]] was being quite persuasive to the ISB about diverting it to his own [[Project Stardust]] like Governor Tarkin did with all funding for the [[Imperial cloning program]] led by [[Chief Scientist]] [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] of the [[Advanced Science Division]] after he died in [[18 BBY]], leaving the 7th Fleet to guard Lothal. In that time, the rebels rescued Syndulla, and after some fighting, AT-ATs destroyed the [[Lothal City fuel depot]],<ref name="Jedi Knight">{{Rebels|Jedi Knight}}</ref> halting production lines for TIE Defender. This affected Thrawn's plea for Palpatine to continue giving his support for the TIE Defender program, and he became apoplectic toward Governor Pryce for trying to cover it up with a [[parade]] to celebrate the death of Jarrus so as punishment for letting her ruthless and prideful behavior give their enemies a victory by completing their mission he marked her for death unless she captured the rebels by the time he returned.<ref name="Dume">{{Rebels|DUME}}</ref>

Shortly after, the Rebels plotted to [[Liberation of Lothal|liberate]] Lothal from the Empire while Thrawn was absent dealing with the [[Imperial–Grysk conflict|Grysks]] and the [[Skirmish against the Third Fleet]]. After ending the skirmish against the traitorous Grand Admiral [[Balanhai Savit]], Thrawn sent Commodore Faro to Coruscant for her new orientation to lead the [[Eleventh Fleet]] when he and Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon]] returned to Lothal with the 7th Fleet and the ''[[Harbinger (Third Fleet)|Harbinger]]'' to end the insurgency on Lothal with one devastating blow. Knowing Thrawn would soon return, they acted quickly by setting a trap for Governor Pryce since she was still marked for death. Pryce fell prey to the trap and was captured, but Thrawn's original bodyguard and [[assassin]] the [[Noghri]] [[Rukh]] survived and sent word to Thrawn afterward. Thrawn soon arrived on the ''Chimaera'' to find that the rebels taken over the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]] and prepared it to launch into space. Thrawn contacted the Rebels, demanding their surrender, to which Bridger replied that they had all of the Imperial ground forces hostage. Thrawn dismissed it as the Rebels actually rescuing the Imperial forces from what he was about to do, and began a bombardment of Capital City. Bridger gave in and surrendered to Thrawn, taking himself to the ''Chimaera''. While on board he met with an altered hologram of the Emperor, presenting as a kindly old man and offering to return Ezra's dead [[Bridger family|parents]] to him. The offer was a ploy meant to trick Bridger into opening the portal to the [[World Between Worlds]] and turn him to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] like he did with Vader. After contemplating the situation, Bridger escaped and made for the bridge to confront Thrawn.<ref name="Family&Farewell" />

[[File:Chimaera_Forcably_Hyperspaced.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Chimaera'' is forcibly pulled into hyperspace by purrgil.]]
The other Rebels managed to activate the Imperial Complex's shield to protect the city from any further bombardment. Furthermore, some of the rebels were circling the city on the ''Ghost'', transmitting on [[Frequency Zero|frequency zero]] to attract [[purrgil]]. Bridger made it to the bridge of the ''Chimaera'' and faced Thrawn when the purrgil arrived and destroyed the blockade, before engaging the ''Chimaera'' and its escort. After taking out the other two Star Destroyers, some of the purrgil attached themselves to the ''Chimaera'' and dragged it into hyperspace, ending the short battle. In the process, Bridger, Thrawn, and the crew of the ''Chimaera'' went missing. With the ''Chimaera'' gone, the Rebels launched and blew up the Imperial Complex, killing the last Imperial forces on Lothal and liberating the planet.<ref name="Family&Farewell" />

===Exile on Peridea===
====Stranded on Peridea====
[[File:Chimaera-PartSix.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The ''Chimaera'' orbiting the Dathomiri fortress of Peridea]]
The ''Chimaera'' survived its trip between galaxies, being taken by the purrgil along their ancient migration routes to the world of Peridea, located in a [[Far galaxy|distant galaxy]], leaving the Star Destroyer battered and severely crippled. Here it stayed in forced exile until the arrival of his old servant [[Morgan Elsbeth]].<ref name="Part Six" /> During this time Thrawn began to rebuild the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="Part Eight" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Ahsoka Date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> the ship was operational, but in poor condition: large sections of the superstructure of both the bridge and the right side lost their armored outer layers, a huge chunk got torn from the Star Destroyer's left side, and two of the three Destroyer-I Ion engines were severely damaged. The ''Chimaera'' was kept aloft by its four Gemon-4 Ion engines which were still functioning.<ref name="Part Six" />

====Escape from Peridea====
Upon Elsbeth's arrival to Peridea, the ''Chimaera'' was positioned above the [[Great Mothers' Fortress]] on the planet. A three rotation long cargo transfer from the Dathomiri catacombs to the ship began by Thrawn's [[Captain of the Guard]] [[Enoch]], as per his agreement with the [[Great Mothers]] for contacting Elsbeth.<ref name="Part Six" /> The ''Chimaera'' remained in place until the cargo transfer was complete where the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' descended from orbit around Peridea. The ''Chimaera'' docked within the giant [[hyperspace transport ring|hyperspace ring]] and escorted off of the world it was stranded on for so long.<ref name="Part Eight" />

[[File:EyeOfSionChimaera-CGSWG.png|left|250px|thumb|The ''Chimaera'' docked with the ''Eye of Sion'']]
[[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Sabine Wren]], and Bridger attempted to prevent the ship's departure, but were unsuccessful. Bridger made it aboard, while Tano and Wren raced to catch up as it rose above Peridea. The ''Eye of Sion'' blasted into [[hyperspace]] before the two could reach it, allowing Thrawn and Bridger to return to [[the galaxy]]. Having finally escaped from his exile, Thrawn had the ''Eye of Sion'' go to the late Elsbeth's homeworld [[Dathomir]].<ref name="Part Eight" />

==Commanders and crew==
Many of the crew of the ''Chimaera'' wore a stylized symbol of a chimaera, either on their arms or [[pauldron]]s, to show their allegiance to Thrawn.<ref name="Through Imperial Eyes" /> The second in command on the ''Chimaera'' was [[Commodore]] Karyn Faro. She took control of the ship whenever Thrawn wasn't present.<ref name="Thrawn" /> Other officers on the ''Chimaera'' included:

*[[Major]] [[Carvia]], [[stormtrooper]] officer<ref name="Thrawn: Treason" />
*Major [[Quach]], [[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] officer<ref name="Thrawn: Treason" />
*[[Commander]] [[Hammerly]],<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" /> [[chief sensor officer]]<ref name="Thrawn: Treason" />
*[[Senior Lieutenant]] [[Lomar]],<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" /> [[Senior communications officer]]<ref name="Thrawn" />
*Senior Lieutenant [[Pyrondi]], [[weapons officer]]<ref name="Thrawn" />
*Senior Lieutenant [[Xoxtin]], [[Chief Hangar Master]]<ref name="Thrawn" />
*[[Lieutenant]]<ref name="Thrawn: Treason" /> [[Agral]], [[helm officer]]<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances" />
*Commander [[Woldar]]<ref name="Zero Hour" />

On board the ship usually served Thrawn's aide, Lieutenant Commander Eli Vanto. The bridge of the starship had its own [[Chimaera's bridge officer corps|officer corps]].<ref name="Thrawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Chimaera-TCGIE.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Chimaera'' as depicted in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity]]
In the current [[canon]] continuity, the ''Chimaera'' first appeared in the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Iron Squadron (episode)|Iron Squadron]]."<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] was first identified in the [[1991]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> It was later retconned within the Legends continuity to have appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] by [[Decipher]]'s [[2000]] [[Death Star II Limited|''Star Wars Customizable Card Game – Death Star II Limited'']].<ref name="CCG 2000">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=''Chimaera''}}</ref> The ''Return of the Jedi'' appearance is Legends-exclusive, as it is impossible in Canon. The Legends version of the ''Chimaera'' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class star Destroyer]].<ref name="HttE Sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

===Discrepancies with the depictions of the dorsal bridge structures===
The ''Chimaera'' is depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''<ref name="Part Six" /> and [[Thrawn: Alliances 1|''Thrawn: Alliances'' 1]] as having a communications array atop its bridge tower,<ref name="TA1">[[Thrawn: Alliances 1|''Thrawn: Alliances'' 1]]</ref> despite being depicted with a tractor beam targeting array during the events of ''Rebels'' which takes place before and after ''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]'', and before ''Ahsoka''.
